title: Facility
description: A physical place operated by government: a city hall, chamber, courthouse, depot, library.

@type.description: A `Facility` is a `Place` and nothing else - it is neither the territory (`Jurisdiction`) nor the body (`GovernmentOrganization`). The occupying organization points here with `schema:location`; meetings point here with `schema:location` too, which is why this belongs in _core rather than in the meetings profile. Types listed here are cleanly Place-only: avoid `GovernmentOffice`, `PoliceStation`, `FireStation`, and `Library`, each of which is dual-typed as `Organization` and `Place` through `LocalBusiness`, collapsing the distinction this profile depends on. Use `GovernmentBuilding` for those buildings instead.

name.description: The facility's public name, e.g. 'City Hall'.

alternateName.description: Other names this facility is known by.

description.description: A plain-language description of the facility.

url.description: Where more information about this facility can be found.

identifier.description: Any scheme-qualified identifiers for this facility beyond its `@id`.

containedInPlace.description: The `Jurisdiction` this facility sits in. Lets a facility be located without duplicating the territorial hierarchy.

openingHoursSpecification.description: schema.org `OpeningHoursSpecification`. Note that `schema:publicAccess` is a Boolean on `Place`, not an hours structure - a common mistake.

publicAccess.description: Whether the public may enter. Boolean, per schema.org.

isAccessibleForFree.description: Whether visiting this facility costs nothing.

maximumAttendeeCapacity.description: Useful for chambers hosting public meetings.

hasMap.description: A URL to a map of this facility.

branchCode.description: The facility's internal branch or location code, when the organization uses one.

sourceDataset.description: The `Dataset` this record was published as part of.
